info.name: Dvaari Tablet APIs - QR Pairing to Delivery/Doorbell
info.description: Clean tablet-focused Postman collection. OTP login/register APIs are intentionally removed because tablet pairing now starts from QR/device credentials. Resident mobile endpoints are included only where they complete tablet flows such as QR claim, call answer, delivery confirmation and recording access.

item.name: 01 - QR Pairing
item.description: Tablet starts here. OTP login/register is intentionally excluded. The tablet creates a pairing session with bootstrap secret; resident mobile claims QR with accessToken.

Comment: Resident app scans QR and claims the tablet. Kept because QR pairing cannot complete without this backend call.
